name: web-headphone-shop-with-forest-green-banner-and-product-cards
title: Green-and-cream e-commerce for headphones: peach banner with green button, filter pills, product grid and small checkout and category tiles
whatItIs: A tan board with a large white store page under a dark green top bar: logo, nav and search, a peach banner 'Grab Upto 50% Off On Selected Headphone' with a green Buy Now and a woman in a lilac hoodie wearing headphones, a row of filter pills, 'Headphones For You!' with a four-column grid of grey product tiles with prices, stars and outlined Add to Cart buttons (one filled green), and at the right smaller screens for checkout, popular categories, a product page and a list view.
whatItMeans: Fresh and dependable; forest green and peach feel friendly and trustworthy.
techniques: Use forest green for actions and bars.
Make Add to Cart outlined with one filled state.
Present sub-screens in white cards on tan.

vocabulary.definition: Dropdown pills above a product grid.
A button with border and no fill.
A wide banner with an offer.
A small card with an item type and count.
